title: Creatures of the Night Halloween Event - ZooTampa at Lowry Park
blurb: Get ready for Tampa Bay’s number one family-friendly Halloween event! Creatures of the Night returns to ZooTampa this October for 15 nights of howling outdoor experiences, amusing shows, spooky characters, creepy culinary treats and much more! This year’s fun-filled event features several immersive adventures including the all-new Scared of the Dark spooky trail and Ghostly Groves, a family-friendly walk through a haunted neighborhood. Plus, enjoy expanded experiences of returning favorites including more disco boogie fun with the zombies at the Dancing Dead and breathtaking artistic performances from the living fountain at the Enchanted Circle. It’s eerie family fun that for ghouls and goblins of all ages only at ZooTampa!
